zh.title: Chinese carmakers now sell one EV abroad for every two at home
zh.summary: Dwindling sales at home are pushing the cars toward Brazil, Thailand, and the Gulf.
zh.reason: 新闻聚焦中国车企海外扩张，且明确提到巴西、泰国和海湾地区，属于典型的企业国际化动态。
